title: Employer Handbook: Successorship Terms for Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts
content:
For every financing class of the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, experience transfers mandatorily when predecessor and successor share ownership, management or control; without common ownership a successor may apply for a transfer within 90 calendar days after the acquisition; and transferred experience changes the successor's rate from the start of the next calendar quarter.

| Financing class | Transfer mandatory under common ownership, management or control | Application window without common ownership (calendar days after the acquisition) | Successor's rate changes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | Yes | 90 | Start of the next calendar quarter |

**Illustration of the effective quarter (hypothetical dates).** Where transferred experience changes a successor's rate and the transfer is made on 14 May, the start of the next calendar quarter is 1 July, and the changed rate applies from 1 July.

**Illustration of the application window (hypothetical dates).** For an acquisition without common ownership completed on 1 March, the 90th calendar day after the acquisition is 30 May.
